headline: Brass hurricane lantern → United Kingdom: GO (74/100) · sample data
summary_md:
**Brass hurricane lanterns sell for £23–£89 in the UK**, with a median of £42.50 across 25 listings [ev:amazon:a953229d:0] [ev:google_shopping:a825e508:1]. Working back through VAT, markups and freight gives a quote range of **£7.78–£14.00 FOB**, at GBP-INR 112.40 [ev:google_finance:6ae86c9c:0].

UK interest peaks October–December and is up year on year [ev:google_trends:0b56b091:0]. Two of the six top Amazon products checked are made in India [ev:amazon_product:b060435a:0], so Indian lanterns already sell here. The most common complaint is tarnishing [ev:amazon_product:3760fc2a:0]; offering an anti-tarnish lacquer is an easy edge.

The top buyer, Sample Lantern House, runs UK ads and has a trade-account page [ev:amazon:a953229d:10]. Homeware news mentions new independent stores opening [ev:google_news:70105df2:0].

_Sample data for UI development: every name and number here is fictional._

pitches.subject: Handmade brass hurricane lanterns for Sample Lantern House, duty-free from India
pitches.body:
Dear Sample Lantern House buying team,

We are a 30-person brassware workshop in Moradabad, India. We noticed your lantern range and think our antique-gold hurricane lantern would sit well alongside it.

Since 15 July 2026 our products enter the UK at 0% duty under the India–UK CETA. We can offer:
- anti-tarnish lacquer as standard
- double-wall export cartons (drop-tested)
- exact dimensions and a scale photo on every spec sheet

MOQ is 200 pieces, FOB Moradabad from £7.78. May I send photos and a sample?

Kind regards,
[Your name]
[Company], Moradabad
